verdict.rationale: Zoho Books publishes a first-party v3 API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g. Create a Contact, Create an organization) and a downloadable OpenAPI document, so a browsable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in place, so the story's core element is unproven. Missing for 10: an in-docs try-it console, runnable request/response examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Every resource is exposed as a URL.
